title: Azure CAF locations schema (v2)
description: Describes azure/caf/schema.locations.json: a map from Azure region name (as used by Azure Resource Manager, e.g. westeurope) to the short abbreviation used in generated names.

version.description: Format version of this document. Bump together with this schema.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the document was generated.

propertyNames.description: Azure region name: lowercase letters and digits, no separators.

additionalProperties.description: Region abbreviation: lowercase letters and digits, 2 to 6 characters.
